name: io.github.whosman/ruleswatch
title: RulesWatch
description: Polymarket and Kalshi market rules, with each recorded edit shown before and after.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Find Polymarket and Kalshi markets by words in the title, an exact market id, a Kalshi series, event or market ticker, or a market link. Returns each market's venue, id, title, open or closed status, Yes price and RulesWatch link, and a few recent rule edits on matching titles. Use it to find a market's venue and id from its name or link.

query.description: One or two distinctive title words ("Fed rate", "Senate Ohio"), a market id, a Kalshi ticker, or a Polymarket, Kalshi or RulesWatch market link.

venue.description: Only markets on this venue: pm (or polymarket) or kalshi. Leave out for both.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: One Polymarket or Kalshi market: the rules in force now, the resolution source, end date, open or closed status, Yes price, and every recorded edit to its rules, source, end date or title, newest first, with the removed and added words. Use it when the user asks what a market's rules say or whether they changed. Pass the market's link as id when you have it, or venue and id from search_markets. An unknown id returns suggestions; a Kalshi series or event ticker returns the markets under it.

venue.description: pm (or polymarket) for Polymarket, kalshi for Kalshi. Can be left out when id is a link.

id.description: The market: a Polymarket market id (a number, like 562802), a Kalshi market ticker (like KXFEDDECISION-26DEC-H25, any case), or the market's Polymarket, Kalshi or RulesWatch link as the user pasted it. With a link, venue can be left out.

history_limit.description: How many recorded edits to return, newest first. Default 10; more than 20 is read as 20.

tools.name: recent_rule_changes
tools.description: The newest recorded edits to Polymarket and Kalshi market rules, newest first, each with the removed and added words, the Yes price at the edit and a link. Filter by venue, kind of edit, category or title words. Use it for questions like "what rules changed this week" or "any new Kalshi clarifications".

limit.description: How many edits to return, 1 to 20. Default 10.

venue.description: Only edits on this venue: pm (or polymarket) or kalshi. Leave out for both.

kind.description: Only this kind of edit: clarification (text added to settle a case), rules (rules text edited), source (resolution source changed), dispute (Polymarket outcome disputed), dates (end date moved), title (title changed). Leave out for all of them.

category.description: Only markets in this category. Leave out for all.

query.description: Only edits on markets whose title holds these words, as a phrase, like "Fed" or "Senate". Leave out for every market.

before_id.description: For the next page: the next_before_id from the previous answer.

tools.name: get_rule_change
tools.description: One recorded rule edit by its id: the full text before and after on each changed field, the removed and added words, when it was recorded, the Yes price before, at and after, the other markets the same edit landed on, and the market's other edits. Ids come from a list of recent edits, a market's edit history, or a RulesWatch change link (/change/<id>).

id.description: The edit's id: the number in its RulesWatch link (https://ruleswatch.com/change/1234 is 1234), or the id from recent_rule_changes or a market's history. The link itself is also accepted.

tools.name: get_watch_link
tools.description: Use when the user wants to be told, alerted or notified when a Polymarket or Kalshi market's rules, resolution source, end date or title change, or wants to watch, follow or track a market for rule edits. Returns a RulesWatch link that opens with that market ready to watch, what an alert covers, and the plan limits. It does not create a watch or change anything: the user opens the link and presses Watch. Pass the market's link as id, or venue and id from search_markets.

venue.description: pm (or polymarket) for Polymarket, kalshi for Kalshi. Can be left out when id is a link.

id.description: The market: a Polymarket market id (a number, like 562802), a Kalshi market ticker (like KXFEDDECISION-26DEC-H25, any case), or the market's Polymarket, Kalshi or RulesWatch link as the user pasted it. With a link, venue can be left out.
